_about: Sunday brunch, from data/research/day3-brunch.json (walk group plus four rides).

tips.tip: Sweet Diner and Uncle Wolfie's take no brunch reservations. Weekend waits at Sweet Diner can reach 90 minutes, so go early.
Uncle Wolfie's is walk-in only at both locations; Visit Milwaukee says to arrive early because waits are frequent.
Book Café Benelux ahead; one guide calls weekend reservations essential.
Bottomless mimosas in Milwaukee usually run $20-$25 and many need a food order. Downtown picks: The Studio at Saint Kate ($25, 90 min), Central Standard ($25, 90 min), Oak Barrel (10 AM-2 PM).
The Packers kick off at 3:25 PM CT Sunday, so bars with TVs fill up mid-afternoon, after brunch.
